title: PrepaidBalance
description: Current prepaid balance information for a user.

balanceTotal.description: The total prepaid balance across all sources and validity periods

amountMinorUnits.description: Total balance in minor currency units (e.g., cents for EUR/USD). For example, 1000 represents 10.00 in the specified currency.

balances.description: Detailed breakdown of prepaid balance by source and validity period

expiryDate.description: When this balance portion will expire. After this date, the amount will no longer be available for use.

amountMinorUnits.description: Current balance amount in minor currency units

source.description: Origin of this balance portion (e.g., 'Credit' for topped-up amounts, 'Voucher' for promotional credits)

initialAmountMinorUnits.description: Original amount when this balance portion was added, in minor currency units
